objective: Reconstruct a causal-time dynamic atlas of post-20:00 process morphologies without searching for a dominant route or fitting a directional classifier.

relationship_to_prior_work.R18_difference: R18 used causal variables available before 20:00. R24A studies the subsequent 5-minute process trajectory from 20:00 to +12h.
relationship_to_prior_work.R23A2B_result: P2 route association did not survive continuous-path validation; P2 is not reused as a predictor.
relationship_to_prior_work.route_labels: R20 routes are observable outcomes used for mapping only, not assumed causes.

universe.eligibility: exact 144 unique 5-minute timestamps for both Binance BTCUSDT spot and USD-M perpetual from 20:00 UTC inclusive to 08:00 UTC exclusive; event-day hashes must match the R18 source ledger; no imputation or cross-venue splice

data.perpetual: official Binance USD-M futures daily 5m klines
data.event_scale: abs(event_ret_4h) + retreat_from_extreme, frozen in R23A2 input

dynamic_coordinates: spot aligned and counter intrabar excursions
cumulative volume-weighted event-aligned taker flow for spot
cumulative volume-weighted event-aligned taker flow for perpetual
change in log perpetual/spot basis from 20:00

primary_topology.aligned_first_passage: first 5-minute interval whose event-aligned spot intrabar excursion reaches +0.25 event_scale
primary_topology.counter_first_passage: first 5-minute interval whose counter-directional spot intrabar excursion reaches 0.25 event_scale

primary_structural_test.statistic: normalized mutual information between primary topology and R20 route
primary_structural_test.gate: one-sided permutation p < 0.05, bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0, and at least three topology classes with n >= 15 that each occur in at least four years and both polarities
primary_structural_test.interpretation: A pass demonstrates that dynamic topology is a meaningful phenomenological coordinate; it does not demonstrate prediction or causal identification.

secondary_outputs: route distribution and route entropy within each topology
topology distribution by year and polarity
first-passage time distributions at barriers 0.25, 0.50 and 1.00
basis and price-divergence signatures at first passage
forbidden: no topology merge after reading results
no use of future observations before their timestamp
no trading rule or R23B promotion
multiprocess_guardrail: The atlas seeks a grammar of multiple processes and transitions. No topology may be interpreted as a permanently dominant route.
